name: PIANOSTRAIN
source:
The world 50 years past the tragedy.
Main character is a traveler who wanders around the Europe with a single bag. The girl he met along the way accompanies him to the Blinger Forest, where the sender of the love letter lives. She picked up the letter accidentally, but now wants to know the truth about this love letter. The Blinger Forest is full of mysteries that date back to pre-tragedy era.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是悲剧发生50年后的世界。

主人公是一名带着行囊漫游欧洲的旅行者。途中遇到的女孩陪他前往布林格森林，那里住着情书的寄信人。女孩偶然捡到那封信，如今想查明情书背后的真相。布林格森林充满了可以追溯到悲剧发生前的时代之谜。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
